units.source_text: “我想你已经知道了，你我都是干类似行业的，

en.t: I think you already know this, but you and I are in similar lines of work,

units.source_text: 龙助要求来帮忙，说实在的，是因为他希望更多地接近千重子小姐，哪怕半个小时、一个小时也好。”

en.t: and to be honest, Ryusuke asked to come and help because he wanted to get closer to Miss Chieko, even if only for half an hour or an hour.
